description: Read-only Smart Switch query plan. For a current-user profile question, select only the requested USER fields (user_id, user_name, full_name, role, email, phone_number, or is_active); the server enforces the authenticated user id. ONLINE/OFFLINE/ERROR is a DEVICE.status, while SWITCH.status is ON/OFF. To check whether a named switch is online, join SWITCH to DEVICE, select SWITCH.switch_name, DEVICE.name, DEVICE.status, and filter SWITCH.switch_name with LIKE; do not filter DEVICE.status so OFFLINE can also be reported. To list online switches, join DEVICE to SWITCH, select SWITCH.switch_name and DEVICE.name, and filter DEVICE.status = ONLINE plus both active flags. To count active switches connected to online devices, count SWITCH.switch_id after joining DEVICE to SWITCH and filtering DEVICE.status = ONLINE, DEVICE.is_active = 1, and SWITCH.is_active = 1. For online ESP32 lists, use DEVICE and select DEVICE.name, DEVICE.host_name, DEVICE.status, filtering DEVICE.status = ONLINE and DEVICE.is_active = 1. For schedules, join SCHEDULE to SWITCH on SWITCH.switch_id=SCHEDULE.switch_id. Match an identifier such as SW1 with SWITCH.switch_id, not SWITCH.switch_name. For an enabled schedule list, select SCHEDULE.schedul_id, SCHEDULE.action, SCHEDULE.run_time, SCHEDULE.is_enabled, and SWITCH.switch_name; filter SCHEDULE.is_active = 1 and SCHEDULE.is_enabled = 1 and order by SCHEDULE.run_time. The database stores only a time of day, not a calendar date, so do not claim to filter schedules for today specifically. For a count, select COUNT(SCHEDULE.schedul_id) AS total.

tables.description: For schedules, use SCHEDULE and join SWITCH when matching a switch name or id. Filter a switch id such as SW1 by SWITCH.switch_id.

select.description: For current-user profile questions, select only the requested USER fields. For enabled schedule lists, select SCHEDULE.schedul_id, SCHEDULE.action, SCHEDULE.run_time, SCHEDULE.is_enabled, and SWITCH.switch_name. For schedule counts, select COUNT(SCHEDULE.schedul_id) AS total.

joins.description: When SCHEDULE and SWITCH are both requested, join SWITCH with on = SWITCH.switch_id=SCHEDULE.switch_id.

filters.description: For a schedule query, filter SCHEDULE.is_active = 1. Match an id such as SW1 with SWITCH.switch_id using =; match a switch name using SWITCH.switch_name with LIKE. For enabled schedules, also filter SCHEDULE.is_enabled = 1. A time-of-day value cannot be filtered to a specific calendar date.
